findings.reason: a node reaching clause (1) must either invent a boundary derivation the plan never authorises or stop, and the boundary figure is one of the "deliverables the section states".
findings.text: §2 clause (1) requires "the mean distance between the two closed boundaries reported in millimetres" against "imas-efit's stored equilibrium", but the named reference (imas-efit `mastu_epm_45272`, on disk at `tests/data/imas/MASTU/45272/validation/epm`) has an empty boundary outline in all 238 of its slices, so the imas-efit boundary the distance is measured to does not exist in the stored state.

findings.reason: without a stated canonicalisation of the reference (or a conformant reference) the section's own bands fail for a reason that is neither a fit nor a forward disagreement, which is exactly the confounding the case set was chosen to avoid.
findings.text: §2 clause (1) compares flux and q95 bands against imas-efit's stored state on "the MAST-U 45272 magnetics-only reference", but that reference is not convention-clean: measured on slice 0 it reports `psi_axis = -0.0978`, `psi_boundary = -0.0755` (flux increasing outward at `ip = +446 kA`) and `q_95 = -10.45`, which is the COCOS-17-psi-in-a-COS-11-container defect imas-efit's own manifest records for this export, while §2 works in a convention-clean frame; a canonical nova state would be compared against sign-inverted flux and q95 and would miss the 5 %-of-span and q95 ±2.0 bands by sign alone.
